'''Colby Hoff''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] and formerly a pesky business competitor of [[Dark Prince|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]],<ref name="SWE">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' {{C|"Hoff"}}</ref> the [[Underlord|leader]] of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate.<ref name="SOTE" /> After a failed gamble to outsmart Xizor left him ruined,<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|48|Hoff, Colby}}</ref> Colby committed [[Death/Legends|suicide]] by firing a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] into his [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]] and blowing off the back of his head.<ref name="SOTE" />

Seeking to avenge his [[Parent/Legends|father's]] death, [[Hoff (Colby Hoff's son)|Hoff's son]] later ambushed Xizor inside a protected corridor on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="SOTE" /> in [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]].<ref name="Date2">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of the [[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Shadows of the Empire'' novel]] to [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]].</ref> Xizor calmly subdued his assailant and snapped the young man's neck after remarking that Colby Hoff was foolish to have challenged him.<ref name="SOTE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Colby Hoff was first mentioned in the [[1996]] novel [[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Shadows of the Empire'']], written by [[Steve Perry]].<ref name="SOTE" /> The [[1998]] ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' and the [[2000]] ''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Third Edition, Revised and Expanded]]'' state that Xizor had Colby Hoff murdered,<ref name="SWE" /><ref name="AGSWU">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Third Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref> but the [[2008]] ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' later clarified that Hoff committed suicide,<ref name="CSWE" /> which matches the description from the novel.<ref name="SOTE" />
